summary:
# MARS EXPLORER – Interactive Planetary Mapping & Exploration Platform

Mars Explorer is a web-based platform that makes exploring the Red Planet more interesting, interactive, and easier to understand. We developed this project using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Leaflet.js to give users an opportunity to explore Mars through an interactive map.

Users can click on different locations to discover important places such as Olympus Mons, Valles Marineris, Jezero Crater, Gale Crater, and Hellas Planitia. Each location provides useful information, including photographs, geographical details, terrain features, and scientific observations. The platform also includes different map layers, terrain exploration tools, historical rover routes, and distance measurement features.

Our main goal is to bring important information about Mars into one easy-to-use platform. Instead of searching across multiple websites, users can explore different regions and learn about them in one place. This project can help students, researchers, and space enthusiasts develop a better understanding of Mars and inspire curiosity about future space exploration.
